hifi.label: HiFi-GAN
hifi.description: The stock RVC v2 NSF-HiFi-GAN with Applio's 8-period discriminator. Loads the public RVC v2 pretrains. 32, 40 and 48 kHz.

hifi++.label: HiFi-GAN++
hifi++.description: The HiFi-GAN generator trained against RefineGAN v2's discriminator: multi-resolution spectrogram branches, UnivHD and SAN. Needs its own pretrain. 32 kHz only.

refinegan2.label: RefineGAN v2
refinegan2.description: RefineGAN decoder driven by a multi-harmonic excitation source, trained against multi-resolution spectrogram, UnivHD and SAN discriminators. Needs its own pretrain. 32 kHz only.
